scope: Final bounded fresh targeted development bracket for canonical KGW generation bias; not a confirmatory detection claim and not an attack result

generation.paired_randomness: same batch seed for all biases within each key and prompt block

runtime_safeguard.behavior: Return an empty torch.long index tensor when rejection sampling finds no candidates; this is the intended no-op and leaves all non-empty behavior unchanged.

development_history.basis: The fresh v2 bracket showed bias 2.0 failed detection, bias 2.5 passed detection but narrowly failed fixed quality in two of eight cells, and bias 3.0 failed quality broadly.
development_history.finality_rule: This is the final targeted bias-only development bracket. If no candidate passes, stop bias-only tuning and reassess the KGW design.

provisional_thresholds.caveat: Development-only stress thresholds; they cannot be carried into v2 confirmation.

detection_guardrail.global_rule: a bias clears detection only if every targeted key x prefix-length cell reaches at least 40 strict detections out of 50

quality_guardrails.aggregation: paired key x prefix-length cell means over the same 50 prompts
quality_guardrails.global_rule: a candidate clears quality only if all three tolerances hold in every targeted key x prefix-length cell relative to bias 2.0

selection_rule.rule: select the lowest bias in the fixed candidate order that clears both detection and quality guardrails in every targeted cell
selection_rule.failure_consequence: stop bias-only tuning; do not weaken guardrails, change the 1% claim, drop 128 tokens, freeze v2, or launch null generation
selection_rule.success_consequence: run a fresh independent all-ten-key KGW validation at 128, 256 and 512 tokens before any final v2 decision
